description_en: Describes the syntax and examples of the RetouchSkin operation in the facebody category
description_zh: 本文介绍人脸人体（facebody）类目下的智能美肤RetouchSkin的语法及示例
name: RetouchSkin

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored on your on-premises machine or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
Image format requirements:

Image format: JPEG, JPG, and PNG.
Image size: up to 6 MB.
Image resolution: greater than 128 × 128 pixels and less than or equal to 5,000 × 5,000 pixels. The length of the longest side must be less than or equal to 5,000 pixels.
Image content: the image must contain 1 to 10 human portraits, and the skin must account for a significant proportion of the image.
The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.

Image content: if the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, resize the image first. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44688.html
parameters.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
图片格式要求：

图像格式：JPEG、JPG、PNG。
图像大小：不超过6 MB。
图像分辨率：大于128×128像素，小于等于5000×5000像素，最长边小于等于5000像素。
图像内容：包含1～10个人像，且皮肤占比明显的照片。
URL地址中不能包含中文字符。

图像内容：当图像分辨率超过最大限制时，请先将图片进行缩放，调整图片大小，具体请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44688.html
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The intensity of skin smoothing. Valid values: [0, 1.5]. Default value: 1.0. A larger value indicates less visible skin texture
parameters.help_zh: 磨皮力度。取值范围为[0,1.5]，默认为1.0。数值越大皮肤纹理越不明显
parameters.name: retouch_degree

parameters.help_en: The intensity of skin whitening. Valid values: [0, 1.5]. Default value: 1.0. A larger value indicates whiter skin
parameters.help_zh: 美白力度。取值范围为[0,1.5]，默认为1.0。数值越大皮肤越白
parameters.name: whitening_degree

ImageURL.description_en:
The URL of the retouched image.
The URL is a temporary URL and is valid for 30 minutes. It becomes inaccessible after it expires. To retain the file for a long time or permanently, access the URL and download the file to your OSS bucket or other storage space within 30 minutes
ImageURL.description_zh:
美肤后图像的URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间
